note: The root key שׂדד follows the local lexicon's filing of Siddim. The derivation of the name is uncertain.
summary: Siddim names the valley where the kings gathered. Genesis 14:3 identifies it with the Salt Sea.

senses.definition: The name of the valley identified with the Salt Sea.

evidence.note: עֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים gives the valley's name, and הוּא יָם הַמֶּלַח identifies the place.
